|| {makuṭottararahasyam} ||
hariḥ om ||
śrīpārvatyuvāca(-)
cidambara mahānanda naṭa nṛtta pradarśakam | rahasyāṇāṃ (nāṃ) rahasyaṃ hi yantraṃ pañcākṣarasya tu || 1 ||
āvayoścakra saṃyogaṃ pṛthaktvaṃ ca mama prabho | nityaṃ hi loka rakṣārthaṃ yantraṃ rakṣākaraṃ mama || 2 ||
yanna kasya cidākhyātaṃ tatpadaṃ brūhi tatvataḥ |
īśvara uvāca(-)
śrīsabhākhyaṃ mahāyantraṃ mama rūpapradarśakam || 3 ||
rahasyānāṃ rahasyaṃ tu cakraṃ devi tvadātmakam | ahaṃ pañcākṣaraṃ sākṣāt tvaṃ tu pañcadaśākṣarī || 4 ||
ahaṃ navākṣaraṃ sākṣāt tvañca devī navātmikā | āvayoścakrasamelaṃ viṣṇvādīnāma gocaram || 5 ||
tava snehāt pravakṣyāmi cakraṃ prastāralakṣaṇam | mānañca cakrayogañca pṛthaktvaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 6 ||
mantrayogaṃ mahāgaurī sāvadhānamanāḥ śṛṇu | sthānaṃ cidambaraṃ prāpya prāsādaṃ mantra viham || 7 ||
(ṭhe Yantra is drawn and worśipped in cidambaram (verse 7), which is thus probably where it was redacted.)
praviśyodaṅmukho bhūtvā guruṃ dhyātvā samāhitaḥ | dhyāyaṃ cidambaraprasannātma darpaṇe pratibimbavat || 8 ||
dhyāyan dhyāyet tathā gaurīṃ nirmalecitta darpaṇe | gandhādibhiralaṃ kṛtya svadehaṃ mantra vigraham || 9 ||
citte cidambaraṃ śuddhaṃ nirmale tatra vigraham | ānandamamalaṃ nityaṃ nṛtyantaṃ māṃ maheśvarī || 10 ||
vāmabhāge svatantrasthāṃ cidrūpāṃ sarvasākṣiṇīm | tvāṃ devi manasābhyarcya soḍaśai rūpa cārakaiḥ || 11 ||
cittabhittau yathā devī prāsādottarapārśvataḥ | māyātmika mahābhakti prāsādā vṛttike priye || 12 ||
nityaṃ hi lokarakṣārthaṃ sakalīkṛtavigraham | mahāhṛdayamadhyasthāṃ nṛttamūrtiṃ parāṃ śivām || 13 ||
(tāvakaṃ māmakaṃ devi yāmale ca svatantrake || 13 ||)
dṛṣṭvā samyag guro dṛṣṭvā prasthāraṃ mantravigraham | (*) likhet cakre ca vidhivadāvayośca vapuḥ priye ||
ṣaṇṇavatyaṅgulā yāmā vistāraṃ cāpi tatsamam | brahmasūtrañca vṛttañca kṛtvā pūrvaṃ prasannadhīḥ ||
catvārīśāṃśakaṃ kṛtvā saṣṭa tanmadhyamaṃ priye || 16 ||
vedāt mūrti devī ca didhiścāhu guṇa tava | svantantramādyamaparaṃ yāmalaṃ tu śivātmakam || 17 ||
svatantraṃ dvividhaṃ proktaṃ dvisapratyaṃgulātmakam | devī mālaṃ karṇikā svā daśadhāsaṃvibhajyatām || 18 ||
devī stuto me gaṃgā vallīstuteti yathā kramam | pātayannava sūtrāṇi navānāṃ pārśvayoḥ mṛjet || 19 ||
ādyante ca tadantasthe tadantasthena madhyame | madhyamaṃ ca tathātoyaṃ guṇabhāgaṃ yathā mṛjet || 20 ||
caturthe navamī caiva pañcamī ca tṛtīyagā |
dvitīyā navamī spṛṣṭvā ||
ṣaṣṭhī dvitīyagā cāsyād aṣṭamī prathamā gata || 21 ||
saptami vṛtta śeśasvācchaktayaḥ pañcamīritā | prathamā saptamaspṛṣṭvā caturthā caṣṭamāṃgatā || 22 ||
dvitīyā navamī spṛṣṭvā tṛtīyāvṛttagastathā | ityevaṃ karma sūtrāṇī yojayet sūtrapārśvayoḥ || 23 ||
evaṃ caro vahniṃ madhyamālocya vinyaset | vṛttaṃ spṛṣṭvā ṣaḍaśrantu tadaspṛṣṭvāṣṭakaṃ priye || 24 ||
madhyatriyaśraṃmadhye tu tiryak karṇagatāni ca | (dyante ca tada?) sūtrāṇi pātayeddevi ṣoḍaśāśraṃ yathā kramam || 25 ||
caturdaśārakaṃ caiva daśāradvayameva ca | aṣṭāśrañca triyaśrañca siddhitve ca na saṃśayaḥ || 26 ||
evantu tava cakrasya racanāṃ parameśvarī | viracya tava cakrantu mama cakraṃ tato pari || 27 ||
ṣaṇṇavatyaṃgulāyāmaṃ vistāraṃ cāpi tatsamam | caturaśrasamaṃkṛtvā dvātriṃśatirīśakam || 28 ||
vibhajya pādayodau caturthāṃśake same |
sūtrāṇi paritaḥ prājñaḥ tadantaścaturaśrakam || 28 ||
aṣṭādaśāṃśakaṃ kṛtvā tanmadhye vibhajet priye | kalāṃśamūrdhvatā kṛtvā tiryak saptadaśāṃśakam || 29 ||
sūtrāddakṣiṇamārabhya navamaṃ madhyamaṃ bhavet | sūtrāt paścimārabhya navamaṃ madhyamaṃ bhavet || 30 ||
vibhāge naiva sūtrāṇi tāḍayedamunaiva tu | madhyato dikpade ṣaṭke sārdhe tanmaṇḍalaṃ bhramet || 31 ||
tadbāhyeka pade sārdhe bhrāmayenmaṇḍalaṃ priye | tadbahistricatuḥ pañca cāṅgulairmaṇḍaladvayam || 32 ||
antarmaṇḍalakāle tu pādārdhenaiva maṇḍalam | maṇḍalatraya madhye tu maṇḍalantu paribhramet || 33 ||
maṇḍalatraya madhyastha śākhāśca parimārjayet | navakhaṇḍā yathā bhūmirna ca khaṇḍātmakaṃ tathā || 34 ||
mahāvīthyāṃ madhyakhaṇḍaṃ mahī hṛdaya paṅkajam | koṇastha caturaśrāṇi vyūhārthaṃ parikalpayet || 35 ||
vibhajya pañcaghātāni catussūtrāṇi madhyataḥ | tiryak pañca sadā ucantvagnyādīśāntakeṣu ca ||
teṣu koṣṭheṣu vilikhet agnyā dīśāntakeṣu ca ||
vyūheṣu pañca pañcārṇānupadeśa vidhānataḥ | śikārañca nakārañca yanmayā parikīrtitam || 37 ||
yama vāri nakārañca pāśi praṇavameva hi | tasya madhye nakārañca yakārañca makārakam ||
na ca pañcātmavā likhya śikāraṃ tu tato nyaset | ma vāśineya ityāhu rāgneyaṃ pañca pañcakam || 39 ||
atha vakṣye viśeṣeṇa vidhinā nair(-)ṛtaṃ dalam | yañcamañca śivānañca na ca vāmaśikaṃ tathā || 40 ||
śivāya nama ityāhurmaśinośca ya vau tathā || vakārañca nakārañca maśivanteṣvanu kramāt || 41 ||
nair(-)ṛtaṃ dalamityevaṃ śrīgurussaṃpradāyataḥ | athavakṣye ca vāyavyāṃ manugrahamidaṃ guroḥ || 42 ||
mavāya na śikārantu yanavāśi ma eva ca | nama śivāya paścāttu vakāra śimayaṃ na ca || 43 ||
śikārañca yakārañca navamāsteṣvanukramāt | avagrahamidaṃ proktaṃ vāyavyāṃ pañcapañcakaṃ || 44 ||
śikārañca nakārañca mayavā paripūritam | nama śivāya paścāttu makārañca yakārakam || 45 ||
madhye praṇavamālikhya tanmadhye naṃ likhet sudhīḥ | vāśidvau ca patyo nyasya vākāraṃ maśiyanna ca || 46 ||
śivāya nama ityantaṃ īśānaṃ pañcapañcakam | tāḍayedupa sūtrāṇi tiryagūrdhvañca madhyataḥ || 47 ||
dakṣa bhūta pade pāde ṣaṣṭhe caivarddhapādake |
(ūrdhva sūtrāṇi caitāni)
saptamasya tribhāge tu navame daśamarddhake || 48 ||
ūrdhva sūtrāṇi caitāni paścādārabhya vinyaset | pañcamasya caturthāṃśe saptame cāṣṭamarddhake || 49 ||
aṣṭāṃśe cārddhake caiva daśamasya pade punaḥ | tribhāgaika padasyaiva caturdaśa padasya ca || 50 ||
evaṃ dakṣiṇatastiryak sūtrāṇi kramaśolikhet | dakṣabhūta caturthāṃśe cotthitārghyagraka sthitaḥ || 51 ||
ḍolāṅguṣṭhāgrakañcaiva kūrpaṭāvadhireva ca | maṇibandhābhyantaraṃ caiva pāṇe ḍamarukasya hi || 52 ||
ṣaṣṭherddha pādasūtre tu uddhṛtāṃ vyostu gulphakam | maṇibandhaṃ lambapāṇe pratī caiva varānane || 53 ||
uddhṛtāṅghrika jānvostu nipraṃ sapta padādike | abhayasya karasyaiva maṇibandha talāvadhi || 54 ||
saptamasya tripādasyāssthita jānostu niṣṭatakam | sthitāṅgulāgrakaṃ vāme'bhayāṅguṣṭhāvadhi priye || 55 ||
gulpha hikkā prabhāmadhyaṃ navamārabdha sūtrake | navamasvartthake sūtre sthita pārṣṇyāvadhi sthitam || 56 ||
ḍolā kakṣāvadhirvāme netre bāhyāvasānakam | daśamārabdha sūtre tu taddhastastala maddhyamam || 57 ||
kuñcitāṅgulakordhvantat pārṣṇibhyāmantaraṃ punaḥ | aṣṭamasyārdha bhāge tu sphik piṇḍāvapuryathā || 57 ||
daśamārddhaka sūtre tu dvivākūrparayosthitam ||
kuñcitāmmraka jānvarddhaṃ nābhiñcaiva varānane | (evaṃ sūtrodbhavaṃ kṛtvā viśeṣāntañca śāstrataḥ || 57 ||)
dvādaśya tribhāge tu hikkā ca maṇibandhakau | trayodaśārdha sūtre tu cakṣuṣormadhyamaṃ priye || 60 ||
caturdaśatribhāge tūṣṇīśāvadhirūrddhvataḥ | evaṃ sūtrodbhavaṃ kṛtvā viśeṣāntaṃ ca sūtrataḥ || 61 ||
antarmaṇḍala mūtu vahniraśmiprabhā priye | trisaptakṛtvo deveśi raśmayaśva pradarśayet || 1 ||
varṇān vā puṣpikāṃ vāpi savarṇāpuṣpikā'thavā || 2 ||
prādakṣiṇya krameṇaiva vilikhedbāhyamaṇḍale | etaccakraṃ mahāgauri mamarūpa pradarśakam || 3 ||
evaṃ saṃyojyamaccakraṃ mahīhṛdaya madhyataḥ | śilpinā śāstramārgeṇa kāryaṃ pra aṃgapūraṇam || 4 ||
māmakaṃ yāmalaṃ proktaṃ svatantrātāvakaṃ priye | sarvadevātmakaṃ padmaṃ prabhāvalayammūligam || 5 ||
kandanālamayaṃ caiva kesaraṃ karṇikāṃ kramāt | sarvādi pañcakopetaṃ mantra śruti samanvitam || 6 ||
vilikhya kārṇikābhāsaṃ padmamaṣṭadalaṃ priye | etat padmaṃ mahādevi mantrābjaparikalpitam || 7 ||
praṇavaṃ karṇikā madhye nyasenmāyākṣaraṃ bahiḥ | dvāviṃśatiśca rekhāḥ ca madhye praṇava vāmayoḥ || 8 ||
teṣu koṣṭheṣu vilikhedekamekaṃ pradakṣiṇam | ṣaḍakṣaraṃ tu vinyasya prāsantu ṣaḍakṣaram || 8 ||
vāśinamaya vāśiśca namayañca satārakam | nama śivāya ityevaṃ praṇavāntāṃ punaḥ priye || 70 ||
pūrva praṇava madhye tu śikāramamāyāyā vratam | paripañcākṣaraṃ nyasya madhye praṇavamālayoḥ || 71 ||
evaṃ vinyasya mantrābja mabjasyopari nyaset | padatraye'pi māyārṇaṃ māyārūpa tapa smṛtiḥ | 2 ||
satyaṃ hi loka lakṣārthaṃ tanmayādhiṣṭhitaṃ priye | tattatsthāne yathāyogamullikhenmantra vigraham ||
mūrddhādi pāda paryantamaṅga pratyaṅgake'pi ca | akārādi kṣakārāntaṃ praṇavādi namontakam || 4 ||
saṃyojya vinyaseddevīmāmrakāntāṃ mahāmanum | vinyasedguptamantrasya prāṇamantraṃ navākṣaram || 5 ||
pañcārṇānuktamārgeṇa tattatsthāne pravinyaset | aṃguṣṭhe tu yakāraḥ syāt vākāraṃ tarjanī nyaset || 6 ||
śikāraṃ madhyamāṅgulyāṃ makāraṃ syādanāmike | kaniṣṭhe tu na rautaṃ syāt sṛṣṭimārgeṇa ceśvarī || 7 ||
aṃguṣṭhādi kaniṣṭhāntaṃ pañcārṇaṃ pādapāṇiṣu | gulphapāṇyośca jaṃghe ca jānvorū guhya deśake || 8 ||
ṣaḍakṣarāṇi vinyasyā dadhāne kaṭipṛṣṭhake | kukṣau nābhau yathā yogaṃ samaṃ yaṃ praṇavaṃ priye ||
nābhau śivau tu vinyaset stanau urasi pāṇiṣu | bāhū kūrparadeśe tu maṇibandhe maheśvari || 80 ||
na ya mā tu śivau devī vinyaset sūkṣma pañcakam | makāraṃ ca yakārañca śikāraṃ sūkṣmapañcakam || 1 ||
navau tu vinyaseddevī dakṣiṇāgrakarāgrake | ḍamaruṃ valayaścaiva tantu yattu kaṭikramāt || 2 ||
bhāntamādyaṃ vapūrvañca śivāyeti yathā kramam | nayo namavoyeti vāme corddhve karāgrake || 3 ||
jālāke khe yutaṃ vahniṃ mama jyotiprakāśakam | kaṇṭhe karṇāsthi gāsye tu nāsāgre ca yathā kramam || 4 ||
nama śivāya netreṣu śromo mūrdhni yathā kramam | ādyaṃ śivaṃ bhruvormadhye madhye haṃsa sudīptakam || 5 ||
aṃ pratyaṃgake (* *) ntaṃ nyasedbindu yutaṃ priye | dvādaśārṇaṃ jaṭājūṭe gaṃgā māyā vāmake || 6 ||
dhūrdhūraṃ bilva pañca laṃkṛtyakṣara dvayaṃ nyaset | jāntaṃ nṛtyañca saṃyuktaṃ candrakhaṇḍaṃ ca dakṣiṇe || 7 ||
śakti trayamapasmāraṃ sthita sandha pada traye | śiro lalāṭe bhrūmadhye gaṇḍoṣṭha gala dṛksu ca || 8 ||
guptamantraṃ nyaseddevi nābhyā ghāṭorupatsu ca | pārśvayorhṛdaye kaṇṭhe jaṭhare padayorhanau ||
mukhe bhruvorlalāṭe ca prāṇavarṇaṃ nyaset priye | anuloma vilomena haṃsaṃ hṛdaya pārśvake || 90 ||
ādhāre hṛdaye liṃge jaṭhare pāda mūlayoḥ | nyasennavātmakaṃ devi karṇe vakṣasi baindave || 1 ||
yeṣu sthāneṣu vinyasya mamāṃge'pi namātmakām | mālāśca vinyaseddevī karṇe sākṣānmahāmanum || 2 ||
evaṃ vinyasya mantrāṇāṃ vyomavyāpi pade kramāt | prādakṣiṇya krameṇaiva prabhāmūle tu vinyaset || 3 ||
likheddvādaśa vidyāśca mamarūpa pradarśakāḥ | vinyaseddevi mūle tu śivāyeti pradakṣiṇam || 4 ||
trisapta kṛtvo vidhiṣu pañcakeṣu pareṣu ca | dakṣiṇāṃ vithimārabhya prādakṣiṇya kramāllikhet || 5 ||
hari haretyabhimukhaṃ tato vāruṇa pañcakam | hrīṃ śrīṃ aiṃ haṃ saścetyuttareṣu padeṣu ca || 6 ||
lavarayaha ityevaṃ pūrvakeṣu padeṣu ca | nama śivāya mantreṇa lavaraya hā kṣaram likhet || 6 ||
jīvākṣareṇa saṃyuktaṃ caturdikṣu prapūrayet |
(a i u e o iti jīvākṣaram)
śrīṃ hrīṃ aiṃ klīṃ haṃ saśceti likhet kramāt || 8 ||
evaṃ vinyasya mantrāṇāṃ mamāṅge'pi madātmake | cakre ca mārjayeddevī mamāṅgasya bahiḥ sthitāḥ || 9 ||
rekhāśca mārjayecchakti cakradevī tadātmakam | vāmabhāge svatantrasyāṃ nṛttālokanalīlayā || 100 ||
śivakāmāṃ parāṃ devī śivakāmasya sundarīm | athavā yāmale vāme prabhāvalaya madhyagām || 101 ||
tvāñca māñca yathā tatvaṃ jñātvā gurumukhāt priye | ālayoścakra saṃmelaṃ mantrayogañca tatvataḥ || 102 ||
āgamoktena mārgeṇa yercayantīhamānavāḥ | teṣāṃ hi bhakti mā nityaṃ muktidā darśana priye || 103 ||
jānāmi tava rūpañca jānāsi mama rūpakam | mantrārṇavā mahādevi mantrakṣīrārṇavoddhṛtam || 104 ||
cidambara naṭaśceti mantrarājaṃ sadā japet | idaṃ rahasyaṃ pāpaghnaṃ bhuktidaṃ muktidaṃ priye || 105 ||
tasmāt sarvaṃ parityājya mantrarājaṃ sadā japet | gopanīyaṃ prayatnena na deyaṃ yasya kasya cit || 106 ||
putrāya putra tulyāya dhārmikāya dṛḍhāya ca | dakṣiṇāya viśuddhāya dātavyaṃ hi sadātmane ||
cidambara rahasyārthaṃ avijñāya sudeśikāḥ | kṛtetvanartha dhā(dā) devī kuśalena vipaścitā ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena jñātavyaṃ deśikottamaiḥ ||
|| [iti śrīmakuṭottararahasye mantrayogoddhāre tṛtīya spandaḥ] ||
